items: Animals now have four moods. Wild: as they were. Happy: invited, they stay in their own area, defend it against sieges and dance at its soundsystem. Leashed: invited a second time, they're yours for good. Enraged: offended by a new soundsystem in their area, they besiege the nearest one
Wild and happy animals leave each other alone, and so do wild and enraged; your leashed animals take on the wild and the enraged; the enraged go for the happy; still nobody fights its own kind
Nobody is killed: a knocked-down wild animal lies dazed for a while (you can still invite it), then runs off home; any other knocked down just runs off
Knocked down yourself, your carried sigils are put down where your animals stand, so they stay yours as a parked group
Until the 💌 invites arrive, chatting works the same way: one chat makes an animal happy, a second one leashes it
